overview_description.description: Saturn is an AI technology company that provides financial advice and automates wealth management workflows. Its platform helps financial advisory firms capture and organize client data, automate administrative tasks, generate suitability reports, streamline annual reviews, integrate back-office and advice systems, and manage compliance through file checks and meeting observations. The company also offers CoPlanner tools for advisers and their teams.

about_short_description.short_description: Saturn offers AI-based software for financial advisory firms that automates workflows, compliance, investment research, and data management.

product.name: Data Capture Solutions
product.description: Transforms unstructured client data from meetings and documents into actionable insights, integrating deeply with back-office systems to unify data.

product.name: Workflow Solutions
product.description: Automates manual tasks like suitability letters and annual reviews, creating a digital ecosystem that integrates with existing technology to support business growth.

product.name: Guardian Compliance Suite
product.description: Automates compliance tasks such as file checks and meeting observations to provide visibility into regulatory adherence across client interactions.

product.name: Ateb Insights (formerly Ateb Suitability)
product.description: Provides suitability report templates and writing tools updated to meet current FCA regulations, supporting advisers in producing compliant client reports.
